arena: [생존기] Blur reduces all damage taken by 25% for 10 sec. Time it to the moment the enemy pops their burst cooldowns.
[회피] With Glimpse, you're immune to CC while leaping with Vengeful Retreat and take 20% less damage until you land. Leap back right before an enemy CC cast finishes.
[생존기] Darkness gives allies within 8 yds a chance to avoid attacks for 8 sec, doubled outside of raids. In arena, pop it next to your healer when they're taking burst.
[해제] Reverse Magic removes all harmful magic effects from you and allies within 10 yds and reflects them to the caster. Use it immediately when magic CC lands near your healer.
[해제] With Blood Moon, Consume Magic removes one beneficial magic effect from every enemy within 8 yds of the target. Strip protection effects from two enemies at once when they stand together.
[제어] Imprison incapacitates the target for 1 min but damage can break it; with Detainment the target is immune to both damage and healing. Put it on the enemy healer and attack another target.
[제어] Chaos Nova stuns all nearby enemies for 3 sec. Get on the enemy healer, lock them down, and burst with Essence Break alongside your team.
[차단] Disrupt interrupts a cast and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
bg: [참고] On flag maps, if a healer can't carry, a mobile DPS carries. When you have the flag, clear all slows with Vengeful Retreat and gain distance from chasers with Fel Rush.

[생존기] Rain from Above was picked by 25 of 47 Battleground Blitz players. It lifts you into the air out of harm's way while you can still attack enemies below. Use it when you're focused in a base teamfight.

[제어] Sigil of Misery disorients all enemies on the sigil for 15 sec after 2 sec, but disoriented targets can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
[분담] Spectral Sight reveals stealthed and invisible enemies for 8 sec. When defending a base, check whether enemy stealth classes are sneaking in to capture.
[해제] Reverse Magic removes all harmful magic effects from allies within 10 yds. Use it when several magic CC effects land on allies stacked on a base.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Blur right before the burst.
pvpTalents: Blood Moon, picked by 46 of the top 47 Solo Shuffle players, spreads Consume Magic to all enemies within 8 yds of the target. Glimpse, picked by 43 of 47 Solo Shuffle and 45 of 47 Battleground Blitz players, grants CC immunity and 20% damage reduction during Vengeful Retreat. Reverse Magic, picked by 33 of 47 Solo Shuffle players, removes all harmful magic effects from you and allies within 10 yds and reflects them to the caster.
